reviewMethod: Direct inspection of all six original16-pose atlases, corrected Aragorn atlas, four packed ranged attack rows, and six actual GameCanvas player-impact captures; native alpha sampled for all16 ranged anchors.
notes: Aragorn first source attack4 clipped the sword tip; source preserved and image_gen corrected the same atlas. The selected ranger costume and ordinary sword remain fixed to Fellowship (2001).
Legolas and Lara retain physical bows, arrows, quivers and complete reach. Ranged origins are typed physical-arrow-release, not firearm muzzles.
Solaire keeps the red plume, closed helmet, white sun surcoat and round shield. The team guard action causes zero damage; no lightning or magical shield was added.
Noble Six keeps default grey Mark V(B), opaque amber visor and MA37. Only controlled physical rifle fire is represented.
Mordin retains salarian anatomy and ME2 STG scientist suit. The omni-tool is worn on the wrist; orange Incinerate emission comes from that device. No gun was generated or painted.
The darkened arena, coloured borders and short contact rings are existing game presentation and bounded feedback, not claims of canonical scenery or powers.
All six player-impact captures show complete native equipment and labels. Opposing orientation is separately checked through all192 exact Chromium pixel mirrors.
